environment: Scrubbed child environments; no repository .env loaded; no provider credentials or real sends.

coverage: Redis publish outage and duplicate transport
report publication/event rollback and successful delivery

staticChecks: ESLint for changed/new workflow modules and tests
scope: REPORT_PUBLISHED in-app notifications are the registered durable consumer. Existing direct PDF, AI and provider flows are not claimed migrated.
ui: No new product console or school-facing workflow UI. Mobile, RTL and visual accessibility states are N/A for this infrastructure release; existing inbox retained.
limitations: No production deployment or infrastructure provisioning
Production alert thresholds and service database role require environment configuration
Uncertain external outcomes require provider reconciliation; no exactly-once external claim
Production restore readiness still requires operator sign-off
